read_route_guide_database: read the route guide database JSON file and return a list of Feature protobuf objects
run_read_route_guide_database: run read_route_guide_database to load all features from route_guide_db.json into memory
test_read_route_guide_database: test read_route_guide_database to verify it correctly parses route_guide_db.json into Feature objects
review_read_route_guide_database: review read_route_guide_database to check how it maps JSON entries to protobuf Feature and Point objects
refactor_read_route_guide_database: refactor read_route_guide_database to accept a file path argument instead of hardcoding route_guide_db.json
